basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Agricultural and Food Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for 1 post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research in the project "ANNAPURNA-Bengal", sponsored by the Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal. The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, for 36 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through a process described through any one of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Interdisciplinary technical experience in irrigation engineering, irrigation simulation modelling, IoT-based monitoring and data acquisition, JavaScript programming, image analytics, GIS and remote sensing and web-based application development, with an emphasis on integrating digital technologies into smart irrigation and agricultural water management systems. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The notice prints no HRA or other allowance. The assignment is temporary, with a tenure of 36 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the IIT Kharagpur JRF recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research in the ANNAPURNA-Bengal project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship) or GATE, or through national level examinations conducted by Central Government departments, agencies and institutions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the JRF (Research) post?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice prints the fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates alike. It also gives a State Bank of India account for fee deposit and asks for the transaction details in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 36 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. It is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project.

faq.question: Q9. Does having the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Which department and project is the post in?
faq.answer: The post is in the Department of Agricultural and Food Engineering, in the project "ANNAPURNA-Bengal", sponsored by the Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal.
